counting_rule: audit entries include overlapping coverage collections; problem_groups is a legacy field counting entries, not independent operator families
interpretation: END_TO_END denotes a measured intervention-to-outcome chain, not proof that mean bias uniquely causes loss changes

rows.implementation_boundary: TorchAO AdamW8bit compiled moment save/read and parameter write
rows.numerical_source: blockwise quantization discards a state residual which otherwise enters the next moment recurrence
rows.bias_formation: the saved residual is fed back with beta-weighted history; measured residuals reconstruct later moment differences on fixed real gradient histories
decisive_interventions: same-path residual readback off versus on
key-parameter-only versus complement versus full compensation
rows.training_outcome: two eight-pair 1024-step comparisons support a material loss improvement for correct residual readback; coordinate permutation causes constructed numerical failure
rows.remaining_limit: one checkpoint/model setting; intervention-to-outcome evidence does not establish mean bias rather than variance or nonlinear response as the unique loss cause; constructed failure is not a natural collapse; a production-quality optimizer claim is not made
rows.next_root_cause_test: external model or checkpoint confirmation; not another intervention chosen on the same data

rows.implementation_boundary: Liger fused linear cross entropy plus external chunk-gradient accumulation
rows.numerical_source: finite-precision addition order and accumulation precision of identical dW chunk products
rows.bias_formation: one late training state is reconstructed exactly from ordered chunk additions; Gram reanalysis over the declared split confirms gradient additive/residual means and all three update profile means with current Student mean tests and Holm correction
rows.training_outcome: paired trajectories separate; 4096/10000-step records do not support monotone degradation or collapse
rows.remaining_limit: the reanalysis is conditional on the already observed declared units, is not fresh confirmation, and the fixed-suite update RMS is only 3.08e-9 of repair RMS; it does not establish that this term is sufficient for the observed loss difference
rows.next_root_cause_test: no further claim can be extracted from saved data; a fresh independently sampled state population and matched loss intervention are required to test generality or loss sufficiency

rows.implementation_boundary: training MM/GEMM at lm-head, projection, and input-gradient locations
rows.numerical_source: kernel arithmetic residual and final output rounding are separable for selected fixed-input comparisons
rows.bias_formation: output-rounding conditional effects reproduce for Qwen128; other MM locations show different or noncoherent geometry, so one common cross-model root is not established
rows.training_outcome: historical trajectories separate, but robust cross-state direction is case-dependent
rows.remaining_limit: Qwen128 rounding-only preservation has seven tiny nonzero delivery remainders in 128 repeats; Phi transport reconstruction is approximate
rows.next_root_cause_test: same-operands factorial separating accumulation arithmetic, final cast, and their interaction on an independent state bank

rows.implementation_boundary: Qwen layer-27 softmax backward using reconstructed versus higher-precision saved probability
rows.numerical_source: same-call evidence isolates an inconsistency: BF16 saved scaled scores are combined with FP32 maximum and denominator from the pre-materialized calculation
rows.bias_formation: J_softmax(p)^T 1 = p(1-sum(p)); all 114688 observed rows have nonzero reconstructed mass defect, while consistent renormalization reduces the maximum defect below 8e-16; the semantic replacement reaches q/k gradients
decisive_interventions: consistent renormalization of the same saved scores
rows.training_outcome: trajectory non-identity exists; the historical persistent-direction gate is not passed
rows.remaining_limit: the fixed-call mass defect is a closed local mechanism, but the two captured states are not independent population units and do not establish a persistent natural update bias
rows.next_root_cause_test: repeat the same-call source measure on an independent state bank, then restore only the consistent saved state before measuring gradient and update direction

rows.implementation_boundary: Qwen3-VL decomposed AOT SiLU VJP versus aten.silu_backward
rows.numerical_source: different finite-precision evaluation of the same derivative expression
rows.bias_formation: positive/negative residual replay reveals a strongly even early optimizer response; it does not establish why the natural VJP residual has nonzero expectation
rows.training_outcome: direct persistence is weak; later separation is feedback-sustained and the loss difference is small
rows.remaining_limit: the natural source distribution and its expectation-level asymmetry are not isolated
rows.next_root_cause_test: factor the derivative evaluation into sigmoid approximation, expression ordering, and final cast using identical operands and a held-out state bank

rows.implementation_boundary: Qwen layer-23 S_bwd/K to q-projection gradient semantic region
rows.numerical_source: the S_bwd input to bmm_76 carries the regional difference; one isolated contributor is fusion-delayed BF16 materialization in layer-23 key RMSNorm plus RoPE
rows.bias_formation: Gq=S_bwd K and dW=Gq^T H identify transport; S-only and joint restoration remove the selected direction, and eager-like intermediate materialization removes the isolated key-forward contribution
rows.training_outcome: a paired trajectory exists under the historical protocol
rows.remaining_limit: fusion-delayed BF16 materialization explains one measured contributor, not the whole carrier; changed upstream logits and overlapping residual-stream paths remain multi-source
rows.next_root_cause_test: treat the closed materialization contributor as a completed subcase; do not claim a unique root for the whole region unless remaining upstream-logit contributors are separately intervened

rows.implementation_boundary: Ministral compiled Triton fused RoPE/position-scaling calculation
rows.numerical_source: same-input implementation evaluation difference; position scaling alone is ruled out as the unique explanation
rows.bias_formation: identical gradient differences produce very different writes under warm versus reset optimizer state; reset also changes the step counter
rows.remaining_limit: the low-level arithmetic source is not isolated and moments are not separated from step-counter effects
rows.next_root_cause_test: same-operands cast/materialization factorial, plus a state comparison holding step counter fixed while changing moments

rows.implementation_boundary: 99 same-input compiled SiLU and RMS-backward output locations
rows.numerical_source: candidate/reference evaluation differs, but each FP32 reference changes multiple arithmetic choices together
rows.bias_formation: fixed-suite total difference is measurable; nonzero mean bias and a unique arithmetic source are not established
rows.remaining_limit: requires targeted source-isolating variants before root-cause claims
rows.next_root_cause_test: select representatives before outcome inspection and run expression-component factorials; do not test all 99 positions independently

rows.implementation_boundary: 31 compiled training regions measured by reference-graph endpoint substitution
rows.numerical_source: region-level candidate/reference difference may include upstream differences
rows.bias_formation: the framework measures actual update effects but cannot assign them to one computation
rows.remaining_limit: same local operands and unique source attribution are absent
rows.next_root_cause_test: promote only selected regions to same-operands comparisons; the collection itself is not a root-cause target
